284171972.description:
Scott's Mineral Box Industries
Vintage Rocks and Minerals Specimen Collection Set
24 Labeled Specimens with Display Box
A classic mid-century educational geology collection produced by Scott's Mineral Box Industries of Custer, South Dakota. Dating to the 1950s to 1960s, these boxed study sets were distributed to rockhounds, students, and tourists visiting the Black Hills. Each natural geological specimen is mounted and identified on a printed compartmentalized tray, illustrating key ore, mineral, and rock classifications from North American deposits.
Includes 24 individually labeled specimens including Gold Ore, Copper Ore, Rose Quartz, Muscovite, Uranium Ore, and Petrified Wood
Accompanied by an additional natural clear quartz crystal point
Housed in the original faux-tooled leatherette textured cardboard box with matching lid
Measures approximately 8.6 inches long by 5.6 inches wide by 1 inch deep
Condition:
Box lid and base remain structurally sound with light corner and edge wear consistent with age. Printed tray is clean and legible with all 24 labeled specimens intact and firmly attached. Loose quartz crystal point is complete with natural terminations and surface inclusions.

284331109.description:
Natural Quartz Geode Specimen Pair
Crystalline Rock Cavity Halves
Raw Mineral Formation, 2 Pieces
This pair of natural geode halves features interior cavities lined with sparkling crystalline quartz and calcite formations resting within a rugged natural rock matrix. Formed millions of years ago in volcanic or sedimentary bubbles, geodes showcase distinctive internal crystal growth patterns, making them enduring favorites among mineral collectors, geology enthusiasts, and natural decor curators.
Includes two matching natural geode halves with exposed crystalline cavities
Densely packed translucent to milky quartz crystal points and druzy clusters
Rough, unaltered exterior host rock with authentic geological texture and coloration
Measures approximately 9 x 5 x 3.5 inches combined and weighs 2.4 lbs
Condition:
Natural geological specimens in raw, unpolished condition. Crystal formations are intact with crisp termination points and natural surface variations. Exterior host rock displays natural earthy textures, fissures, and authentic mineral matrix characteristics consistent with wild-harvested rock specimens.
